title: finding(types): VectorFieldMetadata has two declared keys FieldSchema rejects — `indexed` and `distance_metric`
body:
Observation-class finding, tripped over while implementing #4679. Filed unassigned; not fixed in any PR.

## What is there

`packages/types/src/field-types.ts` declares, on `VectorFieldMetadata` (line ~622):

```ts
export interface VectorFieldMetadata extends BaseFieldMetadata {
  type: 'vector';
  dimensions?: number;
  distance_metric?: 'cosine' | 'euclidean' | 'dot_product';
  /**
   * Whether to index for similarity search
   */
  indexed?: boolean;
  normalize?: boolean;
}
```

This is a **separate** declaration from `BaseFieldMetadata.indexed` (removed in #4679) — a different key, on a different interface, with different prose ("Whether to index for similarity search" vs. "Field index for database optimization").

## Measured on `origin/main`

Repo-wide sweep (`packages/*/src apps/*/src`, excluding `.test.`/`__tests__`) for `.indexed\b|indexed:` found zero hits on any vector-specific code path — the only hit anywhere is an unrelated "0-indexed" prose comment in `GanttView.tsx`. No reader, no writer.

Probed against the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.0.0-rc.6, `FieldSchema.safeParse`:

```
FieldSchema.safeParse({ name: 'x', type: 'vector', indexed: true })
→ unrecognized_keys: ["indexed"]
  "never a FieldSchema key; a field-level index flag built no index (#2377).
   Declare the index in the object's `indexes[]`."

FieldSchema.safeParse({ name: 'x', type: 'vector', dimensions: 768, distance_metric: 'cosine' })
→ unrecognized_keys: ["distance_metric"]
  ("dimensions" is accepted — not flagged)
```

So `VectorFieldMetadata` has **two** dead/rejected keys, not one: `indexed` (same defect class as #4679/#4675) and `distance_metric` (a distinct drift — the spec's vector field shape doesn't recognize it at all, while `dimensions` is fine).

## Why it is worth recording

Same "declared but not delivered" shape as #4679: a field-metadata property that type-checks, reads as supported, and would silently produce a save-blocking `422 INVALID_METADATA` if an AI-written app or widget authored it (per the `FieldSchema.safeParse` rejection precedent established in #4644/#4675/objectstack#4001). Because `VectorFieldMetadata` has two independently-broken keys rather than one clean deletion, it didn't qualify for #4679's bounded in-place exemption (that PR's scope was a single mechanical field removal with pinned evidence; this interface needs its own triage to decide whether `distance_metric` should be renamed/aligned to a real spec key, dropped, or the spec extended — a judgment call, not a mechanical deletion).

Not graded here — severity, and whether `distance_metric` should be fixed by renaming vs. removing vs. extending the spec, are for triage. No `pm:queue`.

Backlinks: #4679 (the sibling `BaseFieldMetadata.indexed` deletion this was found alongside), PR #4675, objectui#4644, objectstack#2377, objectstack#4001.
